General {npc:Bunny Bonecrusher}, of Carlin, sends you to deliver a package of supplies to the Femor Hills watchtower. There, {npc:Thanita} will only give you the delivery password if you rid her of the {creature:Goblin Leader}, whom you have to make leave his room by setting fire to his bed. As a reward you receive 200 elemental arrows.
